+---
+name: pre-commit-review
+description: Run pr-review-toolkit agents over the current `git diff` before staging a commit. Catches CLAUDE.md violations, silent failures, comment rot, and test-coverage gaps in one shot.
+---
+
+# pre-commit-review
+
+Run this **after** finishing a logical chunk of work and **before** staging
+to git. It launches several specialised review agents in parallel on the
+current unstaged diff, surfaces their findings to the user, and stops
+short of committing — the human still decides whether to fix and commit.
+
+## When to use
+
+- A function / file / feature is done and you're about to `git add`.
+- After resolving a bug fix, before pushing.
+- After any rename / refactor that touched more than a couple of files.
+
+Skip for trivial edits (typo fixes, comment-only changes) — the agent
+fan-out cost isn't worth it.
+
+## What it does
+
+1. Read `git diff HEAD` (staged + unstaged) so the agents see the full set about to be committed.
+2. Launch in parallel:
+   - `pr-review-toolkit:code-reviewer` — CLAUDE.md / style adherence
+   - `pr-review-toolkit:silent-failure-hunter` — catch-all blocks,
+     fallbacks, swallowed errors introduced by the diff
+   - `pr-review-toolkit:comment-analyzer` — comments that drifted from
+     the code they describe (only if the diff added / changed comments)
+3. If the diff introduces new types or trait/struct definitions, also
+   run `pr-review-toolkit:type-design-analyzer`.
+4. If the diff is large (≥ 300 LOC), also run `pr-review-toolkit:pr-test-analyzer`
+   to check whether test coverage tracked the change.
+5. Collate findings. Present to the user as a punch list. Do not
+   auto-fix; let the user decide which findings to act on.
+
+## Prereqs
+
+The `pr-review-toolkit` plugin must be enabled in the user's Claude
+Code config. Without it the named agents won't be available — print a
+clear error and fall back to a manual checklist:
+
+```
+[ ] CLAUDE.md hard rules respected (concept stability, no blanket sed)
+[ ] no catch-all that swallows an unexpected error
+[ ] comments still match code
+[ ] every new public type / function has a doc comment
+[ ] tests added or updated for behaviour changes
+```
+
+## Output
+
+After all agents return, print:
+
+```
+## pre-commit-review summary
+
+Findings (N total):
+  - [code-reviewer]    <issue>
+  - [silent-failure]   <issue>
+  - ...
+
+Pass / discuss / fix? (no auto-commit)
+```
+
+Wait for the user's instruction. Never `git add` / `git commit` from
+inside this skill.

index 0000000..f790fe6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci-bot.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,475 @@
+# Robonix CI bot — ChatOps front-end for the GPU testing pipeline.
+#
+# A maintainer comments `@robonix-ci test` on a pull request; this workflow
+# runs the full testing.yml pipeline on the self-hosted GPU runner and edits a
+# single status comment with the pass rate, the failing cases, and where the
+# logs are. No separate hosted bot/server — GitHub Actions IS the bot.
+#
+# ─────────────────────────── SECURITY (read first) ───────────────────────────
+# `issue_comment` runs with the BASE repo's token, so the trigger is gated hard:
+#   1. Only PR comments (not plain issues) whose body starts with the command.
+#   2. Only callers with actual repo permission `admin` or `maintain` may
+#      start a run. A drive-by commenter, org member without repo admin/maintain,
+#      or write-only contributor cannot start work on the self-hosted runner.
+#   3. The actual GPU job still goes through testing.yml's `security-gate` +
+#      `environment: gpu-testing` (required-reviewer approval, once configured),
+#      so even an
+#      authorized comment pauses for a human before touching the 5090.
+
+name: Robonix CI Bot
+
+on:
+  issue_comment:
+    types: [created]
+
+permissions:
+  actions: read
+  contents: write
+  pull-requests: write
+  issues: write
+
+jobs:
+  # ── Parse + authorize the command; open/refresh the status comment ─────────
+  gate:
+    name: Authorize CI command
+    if: >-
+      github.event.issue.pull_request &&
+      contains(github.event.comment.body, '@robonix-ci test')
+    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
+    outputs:
+      authorized: ${{ steps.auth.outputs.authorized }}
+      caller_permission: ${{ steps.auth.outputs.permission }}
+      test_ref: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.test_ref }}
+      merge_ref_available: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.merge_ref_available }}
+      pr_base_ref: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.base_ref }}
+      pr_number: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}
+      pr_title: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.title }}
+      pr_author: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.author }}
+      pr_url: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.url }}
+      pr_head_ref: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.head_ref }}
+      pr_head_repo: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.head_repo }}
+      pr_head_sha: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.head_sha }}
+      triggered_by: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.triggered_by }}
+      comment_id: ${{ steps.say.outputs.comment_id }}
+    steps:
+      - name: Authorize caller permission
+        id: auth
+        uses: actions/github-script@v7
+        with:
+          script: |
+            const username = context.payload.comment.user.login;
+            let permission = 'none';
+            try {
+              const r = await github.rest.repos.getCollaboratorPermissionLevel({
+                owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo, username,
+              });
+              permission = r.data.permission || 'none';
+            } catch (e) {
+              core.notice(`could not resolve repo permission for @${username}: ${e.message}`);
+            }
+            const authorized = ['admin', 'maintain'].includes(permission);
+            core.setOutput('permission', permission);
+            core.setOutput('authorized', String(authorized));
+            if (!authorized) {
+              core.notice(`@${username} has repo permission '${permission}', not allowed to run robonix CI`);
+            }
+
+      - name: Report unauthorized command
+        if: steps.auth.outputs.authorized != 'true'
+        uses: actions/github-script@v7
+        with:
+          script: |
+            const body = [
+              '<!-- robonix-ci-status -->',
+              '### Robonix Webots CI - not authorized',
+              `@${context.payload.comment.user.login} cannot start this self-hosted Webots test run.`,
+              `Required repo permission: \`admin\` or \`maintain\`. Current permission: \`${{ steps.auth.outputs.permission }}\`.`,
+            ].join('\n');
+            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
+              owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo,
+              issue_number: context.payload.issue.number, body,
+            });
+
+      - name: Acknowledge command and resolve PR head
+        id: pr
+        if: steps.auth.outputs.authorized == 'true'
+        uses: actions/github-script@v7
+        with:
+          script: |
+            await github.rest.reactions.createForIssueComment({
+              owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo,
+              comment_id: context.payload.comment.id, content: 'eyes',
+            });
+            const pr = await github.rest.pulls.get({
+              owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo,
+              pull_number: context.payload.issue.number,
+            });
+            const mergeRef = `refs/pull/${pr.data.number}/merge`;
+            let mergeRefAvailable = false;
+            try {
+              await github.rest.git.getRef({
+                owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo,
+                ref: `pull/${pr.data.number}/merge`,
+              });
+              mergeRefAvailable = true;
+            } catch (e) {
+              core.notice(`merge ref ${mergeRef} is unavailable; CI will still test a local merge against the current base`);
+            }
+            const baseRef = pr.data.base?.ref || context.payload.repository.default_branch || 'dev';
+            core.setOutput('test_ref', `refs/heads/${baseRef}`);
+            core.setOutput('merge_ref_available', String(mergeRefAvailable));
+            core.setOutput('base_ref', baseRef);
+            core.setOutput('head_sha', pr.data.head.sha || '');
+            core.setOutput('number', String(pr.data.number));
+            core.setOutput('title', pr.data.title || '');
+            core.setOutput('author', pr.data.user?.login || '');
+            core.setOutput('url', pr.data.html_url || '');
+            core.setOutput('head_ref', pr.data.head.ref || '');
+            core.setOutput('head_repo', pr.data.head.repo?.full_name || '');
+            core.setOutput('triggered_by', context.payload.comment.user.login || '');
+      - name: Create running status comment
+        id: say
+        uses: actions/github-script@v7
+        with:
+          script: |
+            const body = [
+              '<!-- robonix-ci-status -->',
+              '### Robonix Webots CI - running',
+              `Triggered by @${context.payload.comment.user.login}.`,
+              `Testing current base \`${{ steps.pr.outputs.base_ref }}\` locally merged with head \`${{ steps.pr.outputs.head_sha }}\`.`,
+              `[Live logs](${context.serverUrl}/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}/actions/runs/${context.runId})`,
+            ].join('\n');
+            const c = await github.rest.issues.createComment({
+              owner: context.repo.owner, repo: context.repo.repo,
+              issue_number: context.payload.issue.number, body,
+            });
+            core.setOutput('comment_id', c.data.id);
+
+  # ── Run the real pipeline (reuses testing.yml full-stack flow) ─────────────
+  test:
+    name: Run Webots integration tests
+    needs: gate
+    if: needs.gate.result == 'success' && needs.gate.outputs.authorized == 'true'
+    uses: ./.github/workflows/testing.yml
+    with:
+      authorized: true
+      ref: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.test_ref }}
+      pr_number: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.pr_number }}
+      pr_title: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.pr_title }}
+      pr_author: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.pr_author }}
+      pr_url: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.pr_url }}
+      pr_head_ref: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.pr_head_ref }}
+      pr_base_ref: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.pr_base_ref }}
+      pr_head_repo: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.pr_head_repo }}
+      pr_head_sha: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.pr_head_sha }}
+      triggered_by: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.triggered_by }}
+      enable_llm_analysis: true
+    secrets: inherit
+
+  # ── Publish a direct, browser-openable HTML report on GitHub Pages ─────────
+  publish_report:
+    name: Publish skipped-run report site
+    needs: [gate, test]
+    if: always() && needs.gate.result == 'success' && needs.gate.outputs.authorized == 'true' && needs.test.result == 'skipped'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
+    permissions:
+      contents: write
+      actions: read
+    concurrency:
+      group: webots-report-pages
+      cancel-in-progress: false
+    outputs:
+      report_url: ${{ steps.publish_url.outputs.report_url }}
+    env:
+      REPORT_SITE_DIR: /tmp/robonix-report-site-${{ github.run_id }}
+      REPORTS_REPOSITORY: syswonder/robonix-ci-reports
+      REPORTS_BRANCH: main
+      REPORT_BASE_URL: https://syswonder.github.io/robonix-ci-reports
+    steps:
